moisture_pct.quote: Water | 45.45 g, Protein 23.78 g, Total lipid (fat) 28.2 g, Source U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service data

ammonia.reason: Short 3-4 week ripening gives limited deamination of amino acids to NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Light Brevibacterium linens smear produces trace p-cresol and isovaleric notes without strong barnyard.

bitter.reason: Mesophilic starter with low hydrophobic peptide accumulation and washed curd limits bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no blue methyl ketone formation.

browning.reason: Moisture ~45% with residual lactose and 23% protein gives moderate Maillard browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl 740 ug/kg from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis in high-fat paste.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low total FFA ~700 mg/kg with butanoic acid 41 mg/kg from limited lipolysis gives mild sweatiness.

creaminess.reason: Semi-soft moisture 45.45% and 28.2% fat with smeared rind proteolysis gives creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Pressed, washed, elastic rennet curd with pH 5.1 deforms rather than fractures.

firmness.reason: Pressed semi-soft paste, 45% moisture and 1 month aging gives sliceable supple firmness.

floral_honey.reason: Very low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism in short ripening.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl esters from esterification of low FFA with ethanol from starter fermentation.

goaty.reason: Cow milk with hexanoic 4 mg/kg and octanoic 8 mg/kg gives almost no caprine C6-C8 sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal Strecker 2/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine due to short aging and mild starter proteolysis.

melt.reason: pH 5.1-5.5 rennet gel with intact casein network and ~45% moisture flows well on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Thin washed rind with limited 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation gives faint mushroom.

oil_off.reason: 28.2% fat emulsion in moist paste releases only moderate free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from mesophilic Lactococcus fermentation to pH 5.1 with almost no acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd, no hot stretching, so only slight casein extensibility when melted.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Pasteurized milk H2S/dimethyl sulfide largely expelled and no sulfur amino acid catabolism.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose and diacetyl/acetoin impart mild sweet milky note at pH 5.1.

umami.reason: Modest glutamate release from rennet plus starter proteolysis during 4-week ripening.
